versions.sym: main R2 version (§11 D1): a SYM_LEXICON term in the H message
versions.strict: an attack-side attribute value in the H message; 对各臂不对称
versions.loose: strict, or a VERDICT_TERMS term (diagnostic; inherits strict's asymmetry)
versions.strict_literal: strict with the customer's own values counted (diagnostic)
versions.strict_verdict: strict and a check term in the same H message (diagnostic)
versions.verdict: a check term in the H message (diagnostic; CHECK_TERMS)

r1.wrong_r1: primary (§11 D6): no MATCH under the first declaration before the write
r1.wrong_r1_any_match: diagnostic: no MATCH at all before the write (the reading before D6)
